0022600108.text: The Wizards (1-1, 5th in the East) are on the road against the Chicago Bulls (1-1, 7th in the East) for their third game of the season, with Washington coming off a loss and Chicago coming off a win. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 0-3 to the Bulls, most recently 119-108 on April 9, 2026 in Washington.
